critical_code_review_comments: Curve names are lowercase server-side (linear/exponential/step/logistic/hard) but shown as UPPERCASE in the UI select. This is fine functionally but the CURVES set could be exposed via a small GET endpoint so the FE isn't hardcoding the enum in PammPanels.jsx (line 79). If a curve is added server-side it will silently not appear in the dropdown.

PUT /api/pamm/programs/{id}/risk-limits accepts a bare dict payload (no wrapper). The 400 message on unknown top-level keys is 'unknown risk limit: <key>' which is clear, but a swagger/pydantic model would prevent shape drift (e.g., legacy clients wrapping in {limits:{...}} get a confusing 'unknown risk limit: limits' error).

leverage_cap_increase and other new dual-auth kinds silently allow the SAME admin to both create and approve if they logged in twice; verified separately that dualauth.decide_change_request enforces requester!=decider (57/57 regression covers this), but consider surfacing a UI hint that a second identity is required (currently only surfaced via 403 after click).

flatten_failed is dict-shaped in Mongo ({attempts, remaining, first_at, at}) and the FE reads remaining/attempts by key; ensure server always writes the same schema — states.py at line 60-70 already does, sweep.py increments 'attempts' — good. Add a JSON-schema style docstring on FlattenFailedBanner so future refactors don't break the contract.

probability_calibrator holdout_tail_indices threshold is n>=100 → 30% tail (70-99). Consider making the 30% ratio and 100 threshold module-level constants (HOLDOUT_TAIL_MIN_N, HOLDOUT_TAIL_RATIO) for clarity/testability.
